description: Prepare per-package versions and changelogs in a monorepo using the workspace's release tooling (Changesets, Nx release, Lerna, release-please, uv or Cargo workspaces, Go module tags), including changeset files, version bumps for changed packages and their dependents, and per-package changelog entries, without publishing. Use when the user asks to version, bump, add a changeset, prepare a release, or write changelogs for packages in a monorepo. Do not use for single-package repositories (use kit-release-notes), for code changes (use kit-monorepo-change), or to publish, tag, or push, which need an explicit instruction.
